results.controlIntent: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service, throughout all post-design stages of the system development life cycle, to: a. Develop and implement a plan for ongoing security and privacy control assessments; b. Perform [Selection (one or more): unit; integration; system; regression] testing/evaluation [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] at [Assignment: organization-defined depth and coverage]; c. Produce evidence of the execution of the assessment plan and the results of the testing and evaluation; d. Implement a verifiable flaw remediation process; and e. Correct flaws identified during testing and evaluation.

judgment.rationale:
Control SA-11.v2 requires: (a) a plan for ongoing security/privacy control assessments, (b) periodic testing/evaluation at defined depth and coverage, (c) evidence of assessment execution and results, (d) a verifiable flaw remediation process, and (e) correction of identified flaws.

The only evidence retrieved (id: be0ad738-8944-4e31-9ee4-ab1b6956a2ca) shows a single DataQuality monitoring schedule for the churn-predictor-endpoint. This schedule is fundamentally broken: its last run status is "Failed" with the reason "No capture data found — data capture is disabled." This means the monitoring infrastructure cannot collect any data, and the assessment is not actually executing despite being scheduled.

Additionally:
- Only one monitor type (DataQuality) is configured; there are no ModelQuality, ModelBias, or ModelExplainability schedules, indicating severely limited coverage.
- There is no evidence of a formal assessment plan (SA-11.a).
- There is no evidence of unit, integration, system, or regression testing at any defined frequency or depth (SA-11.b).
- There is no evidence of test execution results or assessment artifacts (SA-11.c).
- There is no evidence of a flaw remediation process (SA-11.d).
- There is no evidence that identified flaws (such as the recurring monitor failure) have been corrected (SA-11.e) — in fact, the monitor has been left in a failed state.

The configuration is not substantively adequate: the sole monitoring mechanism is non-functional, coverage is minimal, and none of the other SA-11 sub-requirements are evidenced.
gaps: No evidence of a formal security/privacy control assessment plan (SA-11.a)

Human attestation needed to confirm whether any off-platform testing or assessment documentation exists
